title: The Ostwald Process
description: Ammonia burnt for a millisecond on platinum becomes nitric oxide instead of nitrogen; the selectivity is all in the timing. Unlocks the Platinum-Rhodium Gauze and the Ostwald Converter.

puzzle.goal: Gas flows at Q cubic metres a second through a gauze pack of area A and thickness L. Write the time t each bit of gas spends on the catalyst.
puzzle.name: Residence on the gauze
puzzle.ask: Find t in seconds for L = @{L} m, A = @{A} m² and Q = @{Q} m³/s.
puzzle.method: The pack holds L·A of gas, and Q of it passes each second: a millisecond, which is why the nitric oxide survives.
